transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. Um... well, I just keep messing up little things. Making careless mistakes, I guess. Like writing the wrong time down on a class sheet at the senior center. Or... I'll measure a board and still cut it a hair short because I didn't look at the small print. Just... stuff like that.
Have you noticed problems with your memory?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. My memory seems fine.
Have you tended to make careless mistakes like this since you were a child?

Yeah... I suppose so. Even back in elementary school, I guess. My teachers used to write on my report cards that I was bright, but... well, I'd forget my books. Lose my homework. They said I'd just stare out the window unless someone kept me on track. So... yeah. Always been like that.
Do these attention problems cause trouble for you in more than one part of your life, like at home, work, or school?

I guess so. Yeah. Um... I actually stepped back from helping lead a couple of DIY workshops recently. Just... because of the mix-ups. And at home... my wife usually has to double-check my plans. Just to make sure I don't throw off family visits, or... or the activities at the center. So, yeah.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Um... no. Not really. I wouldn't say I've been feeling down. Just... regular, I guess. I feel alright.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety?

I suppose... sometimes. Like if it's just a quiet evening at the condo. Or... sitting through a whole meeting somewhere. I get this... I don't know, ants-in-my-pants kind of feeling. I just want to get up and... putter around a bit. Check on things. So... yeah. Maybe a little.
Do you often feel anxious or worried?
No, not really. I mean... I don't think so. Just the normal stuff, I guess. Nothing major.
